ambient_events: The book's page is turned back and read and turned forward again.
Linen is shaken out and refolded along its old creases.
Cold comes up off the stone.
description: A small stone building at the south wall with a walled plot behind it. The markers in the plot are all the same size and all the same stone, and each one carries a name and two dates and not one word more.
name: The Quiet Ground
